Stocks dented by inflation risk from rising oil, dicey geopolitics

A man looks at market indices at a stock quotation board outside a brokerage in Tokyo, August 24, 2015. REUTERS/Thomas Peter/File Photo

Rising oil prices, conflict in the Middle East and political uncertainty in Europe kept investors ​on edge on Monday, leaving stocks to drift lower ahead of critical U.S. inflation data later this week.
